title: Fed to Skip Rate Vote at October 2027 Meeting
summary: The Federal Reserve, under Chairman Kevin Warsh, said its Oct. 26-27, 2027, meeting will be a nonvoting strategy session, reducing 2027 to seven rate-voting meetings from the usual eight. The change is part of a communication overhaul that has already shortened post-meeting statements and press briefings.
